select
t.contract_id, t.cashflow_id, t.invoice_kind, t.bp_id, t.billing_status, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = t.bp_id) as bp_name, (select hbm.taxpayer_type from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = t.bp_id) as taxpayer_type, a1.company_id, a5.bp_tax_registry_num, a5.bp_address_phone_num, a5.bp_bank_account, a5.tax_type_rate, a5.billing_way, a5.product_name, t.write_off_flag, t.due_date, a1.contract_status, a5.bank_account_id,
a1.document_category, a1.document_type, a1.business_type, a1.currency, a1.contract_number, a1.billing_method, nvl(t.billing_amount,0) as billing_amount, nvl(t.due_amount,0) as due_amount, (nvl(t.due_amount,0) - nvl(t.billing_amount, 0)) as total_amount
from con_contract_cashflow t, con_contract a1, con_contract_bank_account a5 where t.contract_id = a1.contract_id and a5.contract_id = t.contract_id and not exists (select 1 from acr_invoice_relationship a2 where A2.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = T.CASHFLOW_ID) and t.write_off_flag = 'FULL' and t.billing_status in ('NOT', 'PARTIAL') and t.due_date < sysdate and a1.contract_status != 'NEW'
